shell.title: Your private access to MAISON LISA.
shell.b1: Private conversations directly with {creator}, inside the boutique
shell.b2: Personal photography requests, shaped by your wishes
shell.b3: Secure purchases and protected access to your collections
shell.b4: A welcome discount on your first order
shell.verificationTitle: Discretion and safety, in every detail.
shell.v1: Verification is performed once by a certified identity partner
shell.v2: We receive only the result — never your document images
shell.v3: Your data is processed according to the GDPR

login.title: Welcome back.
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue your conversations, requests and purchases.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Please sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create your account.
register.subtitle: One account for messages, personal requests, purchases and your private collection.
register.displayNameHint: Shown to Lisa in your conversations. A pseudonym is welcome.
register.notifyMessages: Email me when Lisa replies. (Notifications never contain message content.)
register.terms: I accept the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
register.adult: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old. I understand that a secure ID-based age verification is required before messaging or purchasing.
register.adultRequired: Please confirm that you are at least 18 years old.

verifyEmail.title: Please confirm your email.
verifyEmail.body: We have sent a confirmation link to {email}. Please open it to activate your account.
verifyEmail.hint: The link is valid for 48 hours. If nothing arrives within a few minutes, check your spam folder or request a new link.
verifyEmail.sent: A new confirmation link is on its way.
verifyEmail.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
verifyEmail.confirmedTitle: Thank you — your email is confirmed.
verifyEmail.confirmedNextAge: One last step: a short, secure age verification unlocks messaging, personal requests and purchases.

forgot.title: Reset your password.
forgot.body: Enter your email address and we will send you a secure link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.body: For your security, all other sessions will be signed out.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in.
mfa.body: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
